action: Storefront identity projection — first live execution, Amazon-only pilot
mission: TAWVEERI 1.0 — MARKET PROOF EXECUTION, founder-authorized after ADR-311
script: scripts/tps-core/project-storefront-identity.ts (ADR-242) — projects an ALREADY-DECIDED TPS canonical link onto a storefront products row by exact listing equality (same store_id + URL/ASIN). Never re-decides identity, never merges/splits canonicals, never touches a product that already has a link (R3).

sequence.result: 184 clean candidates, 12 vetoed (7 rule classes), 161 low_confidence_candidate, 12 valid/eligible. Zero of the 12 eligible were air_conditioner.

sequence.action: Human precision audit, --audit-sample 12 on the eligible set
sequence.result: All 12 reviewed by name: 10 tablet, 1 accessories-mislabeled-tablet, 1 refrigerator (DANSAT 83L -> canonical labeled 80L, a pre-existing TPS-side rounding/labeling choice, not introduced by this step). No obvious false positive.

sequence.action: WRITE, --stores 2 --go (limit 500, default; only 12 eligible so all 12 written)
sequence.result: WROTE 12 links, 0 skipped. 1 pre-existing unrelated link flagged 'drift' (evidence changed) and correctly left unmodified, not overwritten (R8).

All 12 products.canonical_product_id now populated. Zero writes outside store_id=2 (checked directly). Amazon per-category counts moved exactly as expected (tablet 35->45, accessories 1->2, appliance 60->61). air_conditioner unchanged at 2/268, confirming the pilot correctly did not touch it. Total store-2 linked count: 1552.

sequence.action: Read-only informational check ONLY (no --go): --stores 2 --include-low-confidence --audit-sample 20, to understand WHY air_conditioner wasn't in the safe tier
sequence.result: 147 air_conditioner candidates DO exist with matching TPS evidence, but every one is tier='low_confidence_candidate', not 'valid'. Sampled identity keys show heavy use of placeholder fields: e.g. koolen|window|NO_SERIES|24000|NO_TECH|NO_MODE, unknown|split|NO_SERIES|22000|NO_TECH|cool_only. NOT written — script explicitly reserves --include-low-confidence for 'a later, audited pass', and the founder's own live guardrail this session ('unknown or conflicting identity must remain unlinked rather than be guessed') independently confirms the same stop condition.

conclusion: AC's unlinked-storefront gap is NOT a projection defect (ADR-311 already established this) and is NOT primarily an ambiguity/conflict problem either (R1/R2 pass most of them). It is an IDENTITY-KEY CONFIDENCE gap upstream in normalization: many newly-discovered AC listings (from the Sept 7 discover-firecrawl backlog) have titles too generic to extract cooling-technology/series/mode fields confidently, so TPS's own tier system correctly, by design, holds them at low_confidence rather than valid. Closing this would mean improving AC title-to-identity-key extraction (a normalization/matching-quality change) — which is a different, larger-scope action than storefront projection, and crosses into exactly the class of change ('changing Products 2 identity semantics... matching rules... normalization semantics') the founder's own guardrail says to STOP and return for before touching. Not attempted. Reported instead.
blast_radius_confirmed: Exactly 12 products.canonical_product_id rows changed, all store_id=2 (Amazon), all previously NULL, all reversible via `npx tsx scripts/tps-core/project-storefront-identity.ts --rollback --go`. Zero other stores, zero already-linked products, zero AC products touched.
